designNotes: State: Đã tập is final; deletion by Admin refunds 1 session, removes 1 credit; paid period -> negative adjustment next period.

cases.title: A session in "Đã tập" offers no status change

steps.expected: No status actions (Hủy lịch, Khách không đến) are offered

cases.title: Admin deleting a recorded session refunds 1 session and removes 1 PT credit

steps.action: As Admin, delete a "Đã tập" session from the check-in history with a reason
steps.expected: Sessions left rise by exactly 1, the PT has exactly 1 credit less, and the session is in the trash

cases.manualReason: Changes shared money and session data (deletion); kept manual until scoped cleanup exists.

cases.title: Deleting a session in a paid period adds an adjustment line to the next period

steps.action: Delete a session whose period was already paid to the PT
steps.expected: The paid voucher is unchanged and the next period has a negative adjustment of 1 session

cases.manualReason: Needs a paid payout period prepared first and arithmetic across periods.
